newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Lufthansa steps up Sweden-E Midlands cargos.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa steps up Sweden-E Midlands cargos.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG said on Tuesday it had increased the frequency of its freight operation on the Frankfurt-Stockholm-East Midlands-Frankfurt line to five times weekly.
"From last week we increased the frequency from four to five times weekly," Lufthansa Cargo regional director Sweden Sven Ahlberg told Reuters.
Lufthansa Cargo, an autonomous unit of German carrier Deutsche Lufthansa AG, started the service in April.
"We saw already in the first week there was a need for this extra frequency," Ahlberg said.
The Boeing 737QC, with a total freight capacity of about 15 tonnes, would now operate on Fridays in addition to Monday through Thursday, Ahlberg said.
The service was operating with good load factors from Stockholm, he said.
"We split it in Frankfurt so it's normally full when it leaves Arlanda. At the moment there's an uplift of four to five tonnes on it from Sweden," Ahlberg said.
"It's in an introductory stage so we have good hopes for it," he said.
